title: STM32 MP3 Player
description: Multiple Protocols UART, SPI, GPIO, I2S, Display. Music Player, Timer, Alarm clock in USB sized device. Unit Testing and CI using GitHub Actions.

title: MPAi Web App
description: Created a modern, interactive frontend using Vue.js and vanilla JS/CSS. Integrated a database of over 1,000 Steam games with dynamic data rendering. Collaborated on frontend/backend architecture and API connections.

title: EVolocity Energy Resource Monitor
description: Developed a device to monitor voltage, current, and power from a standard power outlet. Displayed on a website using API integration, with offline support. Simulated analog circuitry in LTSpice and built a custom PCB.
